tasks.label: set admin token secret
args: $token = ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 16)); Write-Output "ADMIN_TOKEN=$token"; $token | npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN

tasks.label: set admin token secret cmd
args: for /f %i in ('node -e "console.log(require(\"crypto\").randomBytes(24).toString(\"hex\"))"') do @echo ADMIN_TOKEN=%i && echo %i| npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN

tasks.label: probe mexc funding endpoint
args: $urls = @('https://contract.mexc.com/api/v1/contract/funding_rate/BTC_USDT','https://contract.mexc.com/api/v1/contract/funding_rate/history/BTC_USDT','https://contract.mexc.com/api/v1/contract/funding_rate?symbol=BTC_USDT'); foreach ($url in $urls) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing $url; Write-Host ('URL: ' + $url); Write-Host $r.Content } catch { Write-Host ('URL: ' + $url); if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) { Write-Host $_.ErrorDetails.Message } else { Write-Host $_.Exception.Message } } }
